overall: MARGINAL now; calm north and east tonight, windy south and Ciron
limiterDetail: Main limiter: wind (E–ESE, sustained per ECMWF). Coron, Culion and Galoc ease from 12.3 kt now to under 7 kt by ~7 PM and stay at 3.5–6.7 kt until Sat ~9 AM. The south grounds dip to ~11 kt around 4–5 PM, then rebuild to 15–17.5 kt from ~7 PM, peak at 18–19.8 kt Sat ~7–8 AM, and ease to ~12–13 kt by Sat 1 PM. Ciron stays at 14–19 kt all 24h. Rain is light today; the next burst is Sat ~6–9 AM in the south and Linapacan. Currents are mild (0.1–0.5 kt now).

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: CLEAR of gale, tropical cyclone wind signal and heavy-rain alerts for Calamian / MIMAROPA. Nothing new since this morning: the latest Palawan item is still General Flood Advisory #2, Region 4-B (MIMAROPA) , Fri 5:37 AM PHT (ITCZ, light to moderate rain and thunderstorms for 12 hours, rivers in Busuanga and Coron listed). That fits ECMWF's light rain today; watch for thunderstorm squalls.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since this morning
items: Saturday flipped from the week's worst day to GOOD. ECMWF now has Sat 17 at 9.9 kt (gusts 17) and ~6.8 mm, down from 13 kt, gusts 20 and ~9.1 mm this morning. Activity Saturday goes from REDUCED to HIGH , and the stock refill moves up a day to Saturday evening (was Sunday evening). The thin stretch is now just today into Saturday daytime. Today (Fri 16) is now the week's worst day (13 kt, gusts 19, ~2.1 mm).
Catch: Saturday's GOOD rating comes from the north and east. The south grounds and Ciron still get 17–20 kt early Saturday (peaking ~8 AM) with a shower burst ~6–9 AM, so their boats start late.

This afternoon: wind picked up in the north (Coron, Culion and Galoc at 12.3 kt, gusts 18), so only 2 grounds are GOOD now (Decabobo and Turda, was 6). The south eased from POOR to MARGINAL (13 kt), and Ciron is POOR (16 kt, gusts 21).

Work from current stock until Saturday evening, when the refill starts. With four GOOD days in a row (Sat–Tue), expect well-stocked deliveries Sunday through Wednesday.

bestWindow.headline: ~8 PM–Sat 9 AM (Coron, Culion, Galoc, Maglalambay) · now–Sat midday (Decabobo)
details: ~8 PM–Sat 9 AM: Coron, Culion and Galoc have 3.5–6.7 kt wind, currents 0.2–0.5 kt and no rain until ~9 AM. Maglalambay joins from ~10 PM (8.5 kt or less). Light showers (0.6–0.9 mm/h) arrive in the north from Sat ~9 AM.

Decabobo, now–Sat midday: 1.1–6.8 kt wind, current 0.1–0.4 kt and only light rain. The model's single best hour is Sat ~6 AM at Decabobo. Turda has the same light wind, but its current runs 0.7–1.0 kt ~6 PM–midnight, so go after ~1 AM (0.3–0.5 kt). Tara's current stays at 0.5 kt or more for most of the period. The model rates the next 24h POOR overall because of the south and Ciron.
Keep boats off Ciron all 24h (14–19 kt), and off Nangalao, Cabunlawan and Decabaitot from ~7 PM to Sat ~11 AM (15–19.8 kt, plus showers ~6–9 AM). Alava gets ~15.6 kt around 8 PM.
